transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I feel like I’m on the verge of being a legendary visionary in fashion and everyone else is too small‑minded to keep up with me. My parents and the people at my job made me come here, but they just don't understand the level I'm operating on.
Have you ever had a similar period before, or been diagnosed with bipolar disorder in the past?

No, I’ve never been diagnosed with bipolar or had anything like this happen in the past. All of these experiences really only started about fifteen months ago, right after I got that promotion at work. Before that, everything was pretty normal.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t, or felt that others are spying on you, controlling your thoughts, or sending you special messages?

Actually, yes. Late at night, I often hear a clear male voice right next to my ear giving me advice and warning me about certain people at work. On top of that, I know for a fact that the big sneaker brands and my coworkers are tracking my phone to copy my ideas and shut me down before I get too powerful.

Have you had any periods during this time when you felt unusually energized or irritable, needed much less sleep, and became more talkative or active than usual, even without hearing voices or feeling watched?

Yeah, I have long stretches where I'm totally wired, barely sleeping, and racing around with nonstop ideas. But honestly, during those high-energy times, I actually *do* hear the voice and feel like I'm being watched. Those things usually happen at the exact same time when I'm in that zone.
Have these high-energy, sleepless periods with the voice and feeling watched lasted continuously for at least one week, or have they been coming and going over months?

They've definitely been coming and going over the past year. The high-energy, sleepless stretches happen on and off throughout the year, but the voice and the feeling of being watched have been much more steady and constant, especially over the last several months.

Have the voice and the feeling that people are watching or tracking you ever been present for at least 2 weeks when you were not feeling unusually energized, needing little sleep, or having racing thoughts?

Yes, absolutely. Even during those low, dead periods when I was just lying in bed with zero energy and not feeling hyped at all, I still heard that voice and stayed sure the companies were tracking me. It didn't stop just because my mood crashed.
Have the voice and the feeling that people are tracking you ever been present for at least 2 weeks when you were not feeling unusually energized, needing little sleep, or having racing thoughts?

Yes, absolutely. There were stretches of two or three weeks where I was totally crashed and just staring at my shoes, but the voice was still whispering warnings to me. Even without any energy or hype, I remained completely certain that those big brands were tracking my phone.

Have you had any periods of at least 2 weeks when you felt very depressed or very high, with the voices or paranoia happening only during those mood episodes? Or have the voices and paranoia also been present when your mood was basically normal?

The voices and the feeling of being tracked definitely happen even when I'm not in one of those high, energetic moods. During those flat, low times when I was just lying in bed with zero energy, I still heard the voice warning me and knew they were tracking my phone. So those things are still there even when my mood isn't hyped up at all.
Have you ever had a stretch of at least 2 weeks where your mood was normal, but you still heard the voice or felt tracked? Or do those experiences only happen when you are clearly manic or depressed?

Yes, they definitely happen when I'm not in those high, manic phases, like during those flat periods where I'm just lying in bed not caring about anything. Even when I have zero energy and feel completely down, the voice still whispers to me and I know I'm being tracked. Those times have easily lasted for two weeks or more without any of the hype.

Have you also had times lasting at least 2 weeks when you felt very depressed or very high, with the voices or paranoia happening only during those mood episodes, or do the voices and paranoia continue even when your mood is basically normal?

Yes, the voices and the feeling of being tracked definitely continue even when my mood isn't high or energetic. During those low, flat periods when I'm just lying in bed not caring about anything, I still hear the voice warning me and feel sure the companies are watching me. Those times have lasted for at least two weeks or more without me feeling hyped up at all.
Have these symptoms been present continuously for at least 6 months, with at least 1 month of clear hallucinations or delusions and no major mood episode during that time?

Yes, everything has been going on for over a year now, ever since my promotion. There have definitely been stretches of a month or more where my mood was totally flat and I wasn't hyped up at all, but I still heard the voice and knew they were tracking me.

Have there also been clear periods of at least 1 week where you felt abnormally high or irritable with much less sleep and racing thoughts, and did those symptoms happen mostly at the same time as the voices and paranoia? Or have the voices and paranoia been present even outside those mood episodes?

Yes, I've had long stretches over the past year where I was totally wired, barely slept, and had racing thoughts, and the voice and paranoia were definitely happening at the exact same time. But those voices and the feeling of being tracked also persisted for weeks during my low, flat periods when I was just lying in bed and not feeling hyped or manic at all.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when you felt depressed, but you did not have any hallucinations, delusions, or paranoia at all?

No, I've never had a low period where those things went away. Even during my most dead times when I'm just staring at my shoes in bed, the voice still whispers warnings and I'm completely sure my phone is being tracked. They just don't stop, even when my mood is totally crashed.

Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when you felt completely normal in mood and energy, with no hallucinations or paranoia at all? Or have the voice and tracking beliefs been present even during those times?

No, I haven't really had any times where I felt completely normal and free of all of this. Even during those flat, low periods when I have no energy, the voice is still warning me and I'm still sure they're tracking my phone.
Have your hallucinations or beliefs ever gone away completely for at least 2 weeks when your mood and energy were otherwise normal, or have they been present most of the time regardless of mood?

No, they have never gone away completely. They are present most of the time regardless of my mood, even when I'm just lying in bed feeling drained and not caring about anything. Even during those low, flat periods, I still hear the voice and believe the brands are watching me.

Have you ever had a full manic or depressive episode that lasted most of the illness, with the hallucinations or paranoia only happening during those mood episodes, or have the psychotic symptoms been present on their own for long periods too?

The high-energy, amped-up periods where I'm barely sleeping and constantly scheming have definitely taken up most of this past year. However, the voice and the feeling of being tracked have also happened on their own, especially during those flat, low times when I was just lying in bed and not feeling hyped up at all.
During the times when you hear the voice or feel tracked, do those symptoms ever happen for at least 2 weeks when you are not having any manic or depressed mood symptoms at all?

Yes, absolutely. Even during those flat, low periods when I wasn't feeling hyped or manic at all, I still heard the male voice warning me and was convinced the companies were tracking my phone. That lasted for weeks at a time while I was just lying in bed not caring about anything.
Have you had any clear periods of at least 2 weeks when you had no hallucinations or paranoia at all, even if your mood was still high or low?

No, I haven't had any periods like that where they just went away. The voice and the feeling of being tracked have been very steady and constant, especially over the last several months. They haven't let up or gone away at all, even when my mood shifted.

Have you ever had a full manic or depressive episode lasting most of the illness, with the voices or tracking beliefs happening only during those mood episodes, or have the psychotic symptoms also been present for long periods when your mood was not clearly high or low?

While the voices and tracking started during my high, manic periods, they definitely didn't stop there. Even during those flat, "dead" periods when I was just lying in bed not caring about anything and not feeling hyped or manic at all, I still heard the voice and remained convinced that companies were watching me.

Have you ever had at least 2 weeks when your mood was completely normal and you had no hallucinations, paranoia, or unusual beliefs at all? Or do the psychotic symptoms keep going even when your mood is not high or depressed?

No, they keep going even when my mood isn't high. Even during those flat, low periods when I'm just lying in bed and not feeling hyped or manic at all, I still hear that male voice warning me and remain convinced that the big companies are tracking my moves.

Have you ever had a clear manic episode and a clear psychotic period that lasted at least 2 weeks when you were not manic or depressed, or did the psychotic symptoms always happen only during mood episodes?

Yes, I've had both. During some of my low, "dead" periods when I was just lying in bed and not feeling hyped or manic at all, I still heard that male voice warning me and remained convinced the companies were tracking me. Those times when I wasn't in a manic high lasted for a couple of weeks or more.

Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when the voices or tracking beliefs were completely gone, even though your mood was still high or low? Or do the psychotic symptoms keep going even when your mood is otherwise normal?

No, they never go away completely like that. Even during my flat, low periods when I don't feel hyped up or energetic at all, I still hear that male voice warning me and remain convinced that the big brands are tracking my phone. They just keep going, even when my mood is completely down.

opening_question.question: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient has a >15-month illness with clear manic symptoms (decreased need for sleep, racing thoughts, increased goal-directed activity, grandiosity) and persistent psychotic symptoms (auditory hallucinations and persecutory delusions). Crucially, the hallucinations/delusions occur for weeks to months outside mood episodes, including at least 2-week periods without manic or depressive symptoms, meeting criteria for schizoaffective disorder, bipolar type rather than schizophrenia.
